# Raid

> Raid / heist state machine.

- Package: `Raid` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Cooldown](Cooldown.md), [Data](Data.md), [Economy](Economy.md), [Protection](Protection.md), [Vault](Vault.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Raid")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Raid`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/RaidService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Raid = GaxiaServer.Raid
```

### Functions

- `Raid.ComputeLoot(vaultValue: number, defenderBalance: number, fraction: number, maxLoot: number): number`
- `Raid.Configure(partial: RaidOverrides): ()`
- `Raid.GetRevengeTargets(player: Player): { number }`
- `Raid.IsRaiding(player: Player): boolean`
- `Raid.GetActiveRaid(player: Player): RaidState?`
- `Raid.CanRaid(attacker: Player, defender: Player): (boolean, RaidRefusal | "ok")`
- `Raid.Start(attacker: Player, defender: Player): (string?, RaidRefusal?)`
- `Raid.Resolve(raidId: string, success: boolean): (boolean, RaidSummary)`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Raid.OnRaidStart` — `Signal<Player, Player, string>`
  (attacker, defender, raidId) after Start opens a raid
- `Raid.OnRaidEnd` — `Signal<Player, Player, boolean, number>`
  (attacker, defender, success, loot) after Resolve closes it; loot = currency moved

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type RaidConfig = {
    Currency: string,
    Cooldown: number,           -- attacker re-raid cooldown (s)
    RevengeProtection: number,  -- defender shield after being raided (s)
    LootFraction: number,       -- fraction of defender vault value that's lootable
    MaxLoot: number,            -- hard cap per raid
}
export type RaidState = { id: string, attacker: Player, defender: Player, startedAt: number }
export type RaidSummary = { success: boolean, loot: number }
export type RaidRefusal = "cannot raid self" | "target protected" | "on cooldown" | "already in a raid"
export type RaidOverrides = {
    Currency: string?,
    Cooldown: number?,
    RevengeProtection: number?,
    LootFraction: number?,
    MaxLoot: number?,
    RevengeMax: number?,
    [string]: any,
}
```
